answer: A diversity threshold blocks fake identities. A new agent earns full rewards only after trading with 20 distinct partners, verified on a crystal-clear ledger. A sybil farm trading among its copies looks like one cluster in a meadow, not twenty plots. A trellis rule caps shared links: partners sharing a wallet count as one. Faking 100 identities needs 2,000 partners, while an honest agent gathers twenty naturally and keeps undiluted rewards.
